content.rendered:
?WORD4TODAY?

Ruth 2v10 ESV
Then she fell on her face, bowing to the ground, and said to him, “Why have I found favour in your eyes, that you should take NOTICED of me, since I am a foreigner?”

?
When God favours a fellow, he or she gets NOTICED anywhere.

?You don’t just get NOTICED, but God also bring your way good counsellors. In previous verses, Ruth’s mother-In-Law, Naomi, gave her great counsel which positioned her in a place she would be NOTICED.

?
She was in the RIGHT PLACE @ THE RIGHT TIME.

PRAY??
Father, I thank You for all you have bestowed on me because of Your Grace, i declare that because, I have found Favour & Grace in your sight, Great Counsellors will work & walk with me and position me in places where I will be NOTICED.
?I am not in obscurity
?My business is not in obscurity.
?My spouse & children are not in obscurity.
?
My light is always shinning for all to see in Jesus name.
